newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-EUROPEAN SOCCER DRAWS -- OFFICIAL CHANGES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EUROPEAN SOCCER DRAWS -- OFFICIAL CHANGES.

text.p: The following official changes were made to the European soccer cup draws by UEFA on Wednesday. The club now listed as the home team in the first leg were originally the away team in each case. UEFA Cup First preliminary round Hapoel Petah Tikvah (Israel) v Flora Tallinn (Estonia) Inter CableTel Cardiff (Wales) v Celtic (Scotland) Grevenmacher (Luxembourg) v Hajduk Split (Croatia) Jablonec (Czech Republic) v Karabakh Agdam (Azerbaijan) Ujpest (Hungary) v Klaksvik (Faroe Islands) --- European Cup Qualifying round Derry City (Ireland) v Maribor Branik (Slovenia) Preliminary round Besiktas (Turkey) v Maribor Branik or Derry City.
